name: smartmontools
summary: Control and monitor S.M.A.R.T. disk storage telemetry
description: smartctl controls and monitors storage systems using the Self-Monitoring, Analysis and Reporting Technology System (S.M.A.R.T.) built into ATA, NVMe, and SCSI disks.

curation.unconfined_reason: Requires issuing direct ioctl calls to raw host NVMe and SATA block devices
